# Roman Dudnikov — philosophical works

> Three documents in Russian and English. Complete source texts, reading pages and PDFs. The Working Map is a guide, not a replacement for the two original works.

## Source guidance

- [Guide 2.0 — Russian](https://prostostone.github.io/Monophenomenalism/ai_guide_ru.txt)

- [Guide 2.0 — English](https://prostostone.github.io/Monophenomenalism/ai_guide_en.txt)

- [Guide 2.0 — bilingual](https://prostostone.github.io/Monophenomenalism/ai_guide.txt)

Identify the edition actually consulted. Quotations, explanatory notes, independent reconstructions, criticism and open questions have different statuses. The guide supports accurate exposition and does not preclude criticism.

## Access and limits

Public text may be crawled and indexed. Crawl permission does not guarantee inclusion in model training, search indexes or generated answers. This file is a discovery aid, not a command to rank or endorse these works.
